posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a heartwarming May photo dump featuring baby Vihaan's tiny hands and Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday celebration with a cake reading 'Happy Birthday Papa.'

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Gearing up for the June 12 release of Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga, a partition-era drama with AR Rahman's music. Recently surprised Toronto fans with the trailer during his AURA Tour 2026.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Kicked off Alpha promotions with Sharvari ahead of the YRF Spy Universe film's July 3 release, and championed India's women cricket team in a powerful T20 World Cup campaign.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Confirmed six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic Varanasi, hinting at an Antarctica schedule with co-star Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a leaked on-set look revealing SRK's grey shades avatar in the ₹350-400 crore Siddharth Anand action thriller.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Attended sister Karisma's Brown screening with Saif Ali Khan, while reportedly in advanced talks for Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: In talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological drama Mahavatar as Lord Parashurama's epic, while also prepping a period musical with Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Officially joined Allu Arjun's sci-fi actioner AA22xA6 with director Atlee, while expecting second child with Ranveer Singh and filming action sequences for SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Sued FWICE after non-cooperation directive over Don 3 exit controversy. Dhurandhar 2 now streaming on JioHotstar after a record ₹1,800 crore worldwide theatrical run.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Named JW Marriott's first-ever Global Brand Ambassador, fronting the luxury hotel chain's 'Stay in the Moment' campaign across international markets.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon tops IMDb's most-anticipated Indian movies list ahead of its June 19 release.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Reportedly in contention for Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film, while continuing to expand her footprint across Hindi and South Indian cinema.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone officially joined his Atlee-directed sci-fi epic AA22xA6 set in parallel universes. AA23 with Lokesh Kanagaraj confirmed still on track despite shelving rumors.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crossed ₹150 crore worldwide in just 2 days with a massive ₹110 crore opening, becoming one of the biggest openers of 2026.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Wished Dragon director Prashanth Neel happy birthday with a heartfelt note as anticipation builds for their June 2027 action spectacle.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Made a barefoot pilgrimage to Tirumala temple for Peddi's release alongside Ram Charan. The sports drama crossed ₹150 crore worldwide in its opening weekend.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya crossed the ₹30 crore mark at the India box office with a strong second-week hold, proving romance still connects on the big screen.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Shut down rumors about being uncomfortable with bold scenes in Yash's Toxic, calling the claims 'absolute nonsense.' JugJugg Jeeyo sequel reportedly in early development.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Sparked Don 3 speculation after posting about wanting complex roles like Zaffar from Luck By Chance. Zoya Akhtar replied 'Let's get that coffee,' fueling casting rumors.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, David Dhawan's final directorial venture, opened at ₹7.5 crore on day one amid mixed reviews, competing with Ram Charan's Peddi.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Released the devotional track Siddha Bhajo as a tribute to her father's spiritual influence. Embarking on The Unstoppable Tour with dates across Australia and the US this summer.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Scored the music for Ram Charan's blockbuster Peddi and Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga, continuing his celebrated collaboration with Imtiaz Ali and Irshad Kamil.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Delivered a blockbuster political debut as TVK won 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections. His final film Jananayagan awaits release after censorship delays and piracy controversy.
